overview.description: The TappAlpha Cboe Magnificent 10 Growth & Daily Income ETF (TMGN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is actively managed to generate income and provide exposure to a concentrated, equal-weight index of large-cap US technology and growth stocks.  The long stock exposure is fixed on a quarterly basis TMGN was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by TappAlpha.

holdings.infoBox: TMGN is an equity ETF with a total of 13 individual holdings. The top holdings are Advanced Micro Devices stock at 11.19%, Palantir Technologies at 10.59%, Meta Platforms at 10.49%, NVIDIA at 9.88%, and Apple at 9.77%.
